validity.researcher_notes: Existence strongly confirmed by independent sources: Hanover County government page, Southern Environmental Law Center, Virginia Mercury, FracTracker Alliance, and the company's own SCC petition (PUR-2021-00211, Notice of Participation on file). Not a GEM-only entity. Correctly classified as a natural gas transmission pipeline (24-inch, per FracTracker/Pipeline & Gas Journal/Marcellus Drilling News) built to connect Transco's interstate mainline to the proposed Chickahominy Power Station (1,600 MW) in Charles City County -- a dedicated lateral/trunk to a single end-user, not a gathering line. No duplicate found on the 46-row roster: this is a standalone single-purpose project, not a relabel of another PID. Length (83 mi), route (Louisa->Hanover->Henrico->New Kent->Charles City Counties, VA), and ownership (Chickahominy Pipeline LLC, 100%, a Balico LLC affiliate) all confirmed by 2+ independent sources. See separate spec concern on Status/ShelvedCancelledType -- the recorded 'shelved' status is stale; independent reporting confirms formal cancellation in March 2022.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's 'shelved'/ShelvedYear=2022 reflects the Feb 14, 2022 pause announcement, which at the time was described (by the company itself, and by Hanover County/SELC/Virginia Mercury) as suspending, not killing, the project. But independent reporting the following month shows a formal cancellation: Chickahominy Power, LLC terminated its 1,600 MW power plant plans in March 2022 ('relocating our development effort to West Virginia and/or Ohio'), and the same March 2022 reporting states Chickahominy Pipeline, LLC itself 'canceled plans to build a gas pipeline' -- confirmed independently again by Construction Dive/AP News (2022-06-21): 'Chickahominy Pipeline LLC canceled the project.' No evidence of revival was found (no re-scoped project under a new name, no renewed SCC/FERC/PJM activity, and the company's own domain -- chickahominypipeline.com -- has since lapsed and redirects to a GoDaddy 'domain for sale' page, consistent with the entity having wound down). This is a dated, sourced, CONFIRMED cancellation (not a dormancy inference), so ShelvedCancelledType should be 'confirmed' with CancelledYear=2022, not left as shelved or set to 'inferred'.

summary: Existence/route/length/ownership/diameter all independently confirmed (non-GEM sources); recorded 'shelved' status is stale -- independent March 2022 reporting shows the project was formally CANCELLED (not just paused) alongside the Chickahominy Power plant it was built to serve.
